_readme: Display-value -> body wire-word laws for raw-display params (map scale==1, no encoding). word = round_half_up(normalized*65534). taper: linear = (v-min)/(max-min); log = log10(v/min)/log10(max/min); int-raw = word IS the raw integer value (stepped kind 0x10; negatives refused pending device verify). confidence 'unknown' entries are refused by the builder. Ranges sourced 2026-07-16 from Axe-Edit's firmware-authoritative effectDefinitions_10_32p2.cache (FW 32.02, decoded via a cross-reference source Tools/an internal tool; layout validated against 3 device-proven map encodings) + repo device anchors;. Family names = preset_body_decode grid families.

DEVICE 2026-07-19 (FW 32.02) EAR-SWEEP SESSION, amp Class-A 30W TB. TWO exact anchors via 01 10: 500 Hz -> norm 0.198965 and 20000 Hz -> norm 1.0. Solving gives fmin=200, fmax=20000 log: log10(500/200)/log10(100) = 0.19897 EXACT. AMP1 pid 83 (Input EQ page 'High Cut'). *** DIRECTION SETTLED BY EAR the same session: raising the number is BRIGHTER (it is a cutoff FREQUENCY, not an amount of cut). Owner A/B'd 500 Hz vs 20000 Hz on a 60 s live switch: 'boom there it is'. This LIFTS the prior interim law 'never set Hi Cut on a Vox/Orange/Matchless model from a spec' for pid 83. *** NOTE the separate AMP pid 7 'High Cut Frequency' (Preamp page) is a DIFFERENT control with a DIFFERENT range -- it read 18300 Hz at norm 0.83020, which does NOT fit [200,20000] log; it still has no law and must be harvested separately.

DEVICE 2026-07-19 (FW 32.02) EAR-SWEEP SESSION. PHASER pid 19. THREE exact 01 10 anchors: -10.00 -> norm 0.0, 5.00 -> norm 0.749992, 10.00 -> norm 1.0. Solves to LINEAR (disp+10)/20 exact. *** THE CONTROL IS BIPOLAR -10..+10, NOT 0..10 *** -- display 0 is the CENTRE of travel, not the bottom. A prior sweep that ran 0->10 covered only the upper half and contributed to a false null. NOTE the map's SET scale for this pid is 31.6228, which is NOT the body normalization; set_parameter still lands correct display values, but the blob/body domain is the linear bipolar law above (same SET-domain != body-domain trap as Delay Time and Megatap Attack). *** DIRECTION SETTLED BY EAR the same session, and it is NOT a lowpass: it moves the RESONANT PEAK FREQUENCY. Owner, sweeping -10 -> +10 at Feedback 70%: at minimum 'honky, bassy, weirdly thumpy, a ton of resonance'; rising it opens 'like someone making an O sound with a small opening of their lips, the O gets bigger and brighter until it becomes a very bright A'; at maximum 'super super bright and jangly, almost ear piercing'. Monotonic, up = brighter, no inversion. *** DEPENDENCY: Tone acts on the resonance, so it is INAUDIBLE at Feedback 0 and dramatic at Feedback 70 -- do not judge or set it without feedback present.
